text_en: David built houses for himself in the city of David, and he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.
text_cn: 达味在达味城为自己建造了宫室，也为天主的约柜预备了一块地方，支搭了一座帐幕。

text_en: Then David commanded that no one but the Levites were to carry the ark of God, for the Lord had chosen them to carry the ark of the Lord and to minister to him forever.
text_cn: 那时，达味心里想：天主的约柜，除肋未人外，谁也不能抬，因为上主只拣选了他们抬上主的约柜，永远奉事他。

text_en: David assembled all Israel in Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the Lord to its place, which he had prepared for it.
text_cn: 达味遂召集了全以色列到耶路撒冷来，为将上主的约柜迎运到他所预备的地方。

text_en: Then David gathered together the descendants of Aaron and the Levites:
text_cn: 他又召集了亚郎的子孙和肋未人：

text_en: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, with one hundred twenty of his kindred;
text_cn: 刻哈特子孙的族长乌黎耳，和他的同族一百二十人；

text_en: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, with two hundred twenty of his kindred;
text_cn: 默辣黎子孙的族长阿撒雅，和他的同族二百二十人，

text_en: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, with one hundred thirty of his kindred;
text_cn: 革尔雄子孙的族长约厄耳，和他的同族一百三十人；

text_en: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, with two hundred of his kindred;
text_cn: 厄里匝番子孙的族长舍玛雅和他的同族二百人；

text_en: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, with eighty of his kindred;
text_cn: 赫贝龙子孙的族长厄里耳，和他的同族八十人；

text_en: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, with one hundred twelve of his kindred.
text_cn: 乌齐耳子孙的族长阿米纳达布和他的同族一百一十二人。

text_en: David summoned the priests Zadok and Abiathar, and the Levites Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.
text_cn: 达味将司祭匝多克、厄贝雅塔尔，及肋未人乌黎耳、阿撒雅、约厄耳，舍玛雅、厄里耳和阿米纳达布召来，

text_en: He said to them, “You are the heads of families of the Levites; sanctify yourselves, you and your kindred, so that you may bring up the ark of the Lord , the God of Israel, to the place that I have prepared for it.
text_cn: 对他们说：“你们既为肋未人的族长，你们与你们的同族兄弟就当圣洁自己， 将上主以色列天主的约柜，抬到我所准备的地方。

text_en: Because you did not carry it the first time, the Lord our God burst out against us, because we did not give it proper care. ”
text_cn: 因为你们初次不在场，我们没有按照规则迎接，所以上主我们的天主打击了我们。”

text_en: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the Lord , the God of Israel.
text_cn: 司祭和肋未人便圣洁自己，好将上主以色列天主的约柜抬上来。

text_en: And the Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders with the poles, as Moses had commanded according to the word of the Lord .
text_cn: 肋未子孙按照梅瑟奉天主的命所吩咐的，用杠杆在肩上抬着上主的约柜。

text_en: David also commanded the chiefs of the Levites to appoint their kindred as the singers to play on musical instruments, on harps and lyres and cymbals, to raise loud sounds of joy.
text_cn: 达味又吩咐肋未人的族长，由他们的同族兄弟中指派一些歌咏者，叫他们用各种乐器、琴瑟和铙（náo）钹，奏出嘹亮欢乐的声音。

text_en: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel; and of his kindred Asaph son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari, their kindred, Ethan son of Kushaiah;
text_cn: 肋未人遂指派了约厄耳的儿子赫曼和他的一个同族贝勒克雅的儿子阿撒夫，并他们同族兄弟默辣黎的子孙中，谷沙雅的儿子厄堂。

text_en: and with them their kindred of the second order, Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, and Mikneiah, and the gatekeepers Obed-edom and Jeiel.
text_cn: 与他们一起的，尚有他们的同族兄弟，组成第二班：则加黎雅、雅阿齐耳、舍米辣摩特、耶希耳、翁尼、厄里阿布、贝纳雅、玛阿色雅、玛提提雅、厄里斐路和米刻乃雅，以及守卫敖贝得厄东和耶希耳。

text_en: The singers Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were to sound bronze cymbals;
text_cn: 至于歌咏者，赫曼、阿撒夫和厄堂打铜钹；

text_en: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah were to play harps according to Alamoth;
text_cn: 则加黎雅、雅阿齐耳、舍米辣摩特、耶希耳、翁尼、厄里阿布、玛阿色雅、贝纳雅弹瑟，调用高音。

text_en: but Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah were to lead with lyres according to the Sheminith.
text_cn: 玛提提雅、厄里斐路、米刻乃雅、敖贝得厄东、耶依耳、阿匝齐雅领先弹琴，调用低音。

text_en: Chenaniah, leader of the Levites in music, was to direct the music, for he understood it.
text_cn: 肋未人的族长革纳尼雅管理歌咏，因他善于歌咏之事。

text_en: Berechiah and Elkanah were to be gatekeepers for the ark.
text_cn: 贝勒基雅和厄耳卡纳为守卫，看守约柜。

text_en: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, were to blow the trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-edom and Jehiah also were to be gatekeepers for the ark.
text_cn: 司祭舍巴尼雅、约沙法特、乃塔乃耳、阿玛赛、则加黎雅、贝纳雅和厄里厄则尔，在天主的约柜前吹号筒；敖贝得厄东和耶希雅为守卫，看守约柜。

text_en: So David and the elders of Israel, and the commanders of the thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord from the house of Obed-edom with rejoicing.
text_cn: 于是达味和以色列的长老并千夫长前去，由敖贝得厄东家中，兴高彩烈地将上主的约柜接上来。

text_en: And because God helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord , they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
text_cn: 由于天主扶助了抬上主约柜的肋未人，他们遂祭献了七头公牛和七只公山羊。

text_en: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as also were all the Levites who were carrying the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the leader of the music of the singers; and David wore a linen ephod.
text_cn: 达味、抬约柜的肋未人、歌咏之长革纳黎雅以及歌咏者，都穿着细麻长衣，达味另外又佩带着细麻的“厄弗得”。

text_en: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting, to the sound of the horn, trumpets, and cymbals, and made loud music on harps and lyres.
text_cn: 全以色列在欢呼、吹角、吹号、击钹、鼓瑟、弹琴、奏乐之中，将上主的约柜接了上来。

text_en: As the ark of the covenant of the Lord came to the city of David, Michal daughter of Saul looked out of the window, and saw King David leaping and dancing; and she despised him in her heart.
text_cn: 上主的约柜进入达味城时，撒乌耳的女儿米加耳由窗内窥看，见达味跳跃舞蹈，心中就轻视他。
